*This website was developed for GV300 Assignment 6 and presents selected work in data visualisation and text analysis using R.*

## Hi, I’m Arissara

I am a Politics and International Relations student with an interest in political behaviour, data analysis, and visual communication. This website presents selected work from GV300, including data visualisation and text analysis completed in R.

## Featured work

This portfolio highlights examples of how quantitative and text-based methods can be used to communicate political ideas clearly. My work focuses on presenting evidence in a simple and accessible way through graphs, reproducible code, and short written interpretation.

## Featured visualisation

This visualisation demonstrates my ability to use R to analyse and present data clearly.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_df <- data.frame(
  category = c("Low", "Medium", "High", "Very high"),
  value = c(8, 18, 32, 14)
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = category, y = value, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  labs(
    title = "Example turnout pattern",
    subtitle = "Illustrative visualisation for portfolio presentation",
    x = "Turnout category",
    y = "Number of constituencies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```
